meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 装上后它会检测你现有的 OpenClaw 安装，读取身份、频道凭据、定时任务等配置，与你逐步对话确认迁移到 NanoClaw v2，并在应用前展示拟定的改动。
howto.when: 当你提到 “migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”、“import from openclaw” 等关键词，或要求把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 先运行发现脚本并给出汇总

say.text: 我的 OpenClaw 装在自定义路径，用它来检测
迁移后助手还叫原来那个名字

howto.what_en: Detects an existing OpenClaw install, reads its identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and other config, then guides an interactive migration into NanoClaw v2, showing proposed changes before applying them.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration" or "import from openclaw" — when you ask to bring an OpenClaw setup over to NanoClaw v2.

say_en.text: Migrate my OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2
Detect my OpenClaw install at a custom path
Keep my old assistant's name in v2
